#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed Valheim server — generated by provision().
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export SteamAppID=892970
cd "<ROOT>/installs/valheim/" || exit 1
exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode -logfile "<ROOT>/installs/valheim/realmcradle-test.log" -name "Test World" -port 2460 -world "TestWorld" -password "${GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD}" -public 0
